about_the_game:
BodyPanic is a four-player multiplayer horror game where you have to survive in an abandoned old house full of secrets and horrors. Your goal is to survive as many nights as possible, facing increasingly dangerous monsters, each of which is unique and requires a special approach.

Game Features:

  • Unique Monsters: Each new day brings new enemies with a variety of abilities and weaknesses. Study their behavior to develop a strategy to fight and survive.

  • Cooperative Play: Play with friends or alone. Playing as a team makes the experience less scary and more fun, while solo playthrough offers you a true test of your mettle.

  • Learning from mistakes: Every decision you make affects the outcome of the game. Learn from your mistakes, adapt and find new tactics to overcome challenges.

  • Atmospheric World: Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of an old house filled with mysteries and unexpected twists and turns. Every corner can hide both danger and clues.

    Boldly enter the world of BodyPanic and see if you can survive until dawn!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470, 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone Required - Headset + SSD Highly Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X ／ Intel Core i5-12600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB / RX 6700 XT GAMING 12GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone Required - Headset + SSD Highly Recommended

short_description: In BodyPanic, survive in an abandoned house with friends or alone. Every night you will be attacked by unique monsters and you will have to find different strategies to fight them. Learn from mistakes, adapt to situations and immerse yourself in the creepy atmosphere.

English*, Russian
